currentTask: Phase 13 — Auth/sync: guest identity, the Google provider, secure credential storage, the API client boundary, the outbox with retry/backoff and idempotency, conflict policies and offline-to-online recovery
nextAction: Build the auth/sync boundary on the contract-first design: a Guest identity through secure storage, the Google provider behind the same interface, the sync outbox worker with retry/backoff and idempotency keys, the conflict policies and the offline-to-online drain

externalBlockers.detail: Live Google sign-in verification needs client IDs. Provider boundary + fake provider are implemented and tested; Guest mode is fully functional.
Live sync verification needs a ReviewTayo API base URL + credentials. Contract-first client and local-only transport are implemented and tested.

partialItems: phase-2: responsive/small-device visual checks require a device or emulator pass
phase-4: device-level offline E2E (no-network relaunch) is covered by file-backed restart tests; device pass tracked for Phase 16
phase-5: physical-device keyboard/screen-reader pass tracked in VISUAL-QA.md; automated label and badge tests are green
phase-6: the onboarding and settings screens are verified by integration tests over a real database; a device pass for the flow's motion and text-size scaling is tracked in VISUAL-QA.md
phase-6: reminders capture intent, time and timezone but are not scheduled until Phase 14

phase-7: Home's light/dark fidelity is asserted against the theme tokens and the screen's rendered styles; device or emulator captures remain pending (no Android SDK in this environment), tracked in VISUAL-QA.md
phase-7: resume-card dismissal is session-only until the mock phase defines what a dismissed session means (D-028)

phase-8: Learn's light/dark fidelity is asserted against the theme tokens and the rendered styles; device or emulator captures of the reference pages remain pending (no Android SDK in this environment), tracked in VISUAL-QA.md
phase-8: quick sheets are one concept summary per subject; richer per-topic sheets are a content task, and the concept page is the shape they would arrive in

phase-9: the quiz's wrong-answer recovery, bookmark and recommendation flows are covered by integration tests over the real router and a seeded database; device captures of the Practice tab, the quiz in both themes and a timed session are tracked in VISUAL-QA.md

phase-9: the drill ranking's weights (weakness/due review/unseen/low coverage/recent lesson) are asserted from the domain, not from a device; tuning them is a content-and-policy task once real answer volume exists

phase-10: Review's deck, grading and four lists are covered by integration tests over the real router and a seeded database; device captures of the count, a card face and revealed, and the four lists are tracked in VISUAL-QA.md

phase-10: review history counts distinct concepts reviewed in the last seven days from each item's lastReviewedAt; an append-only review event log (for streaks of review work rather than of concepts) is not needed until Progress or analytics asks for it

phase-11: Progress's score, mastery list, journey, week and mock row are covered by integration tests over the real router and a seeded database; device captures of the score block with its sparkline, the needs-attention card, the subject bars and this week are tracked in VISUAL-QA.md

phase-11: the Study Score's weights (accuracy 0.5, coverage 0.35, consistency 0.15) come from a seven-day answer window and are asserted from the domain; calibrating them against real examination outcomes is a Phase 16/17 question once real answer volume exists

phase-11: the CSE bank holds four questions per concept while mastery's evidence floor is five, so `Mastered` is not reachable from the current content; more questions per concept is a content task for HANDOFF.md

phase-12: the mock setup, running paper and result are covered by integration tests over the real router and a seeded database; device captures of the setup, a running paper with its clock and grid, the pause panel and the result are tracked in VISUAL-QA.md

phase-12: the full Professional (170) and Sub-Professional (165) papers cannot be served from today's 88-question bank, so the setup screen says the shortfall plainly (`72 of the 170 items`); the paper is scored out of the items it holds rather than the requested count — more questions per concept is a content task for HANDOFF.md

phase-12: pause/resume and the deadline-derived clock are covered by service and domain tests; confirming the clock keeps honest time with the app backgrounded mid-paper is a device pass tracked in VISUAL-QA.md
